relTest.notes: Windows / Mac app: sign in to your DocuInspect account (gear menu, My account) so your license and premium features come from your account, no phone needed. Projects prepared on the computer: Send to the phone button. Aerial imagery: the date and caption next to each photograph; open a photograph full screen to draw on it and change its date and caption, or use the previous caption. Clearer backup progress (Checking instead of Archiving when nothing changed).
